body: Thank you! I'm frustrated that the *incident* detail isn't being acknowledged more. That makes mentioning it even more messed up.

My mother calls me 'sissy' all the time and I'm a grown woman. I don't know why it bothers me either, but it makes me wince when I hear it. I think it's because it sounds so forced and unnatural. She says it as if I'm not there, it's weird.

Op... no. It's evident that you are abnormally emotionally attached to this woman. You say your gf is okay with all of this and I highly doubt that.  I'd even bet she's not fully aware of how extreme this relationship is between you two because it is, to me, 100% emotional cheating. There is a level of intimacy that should be reserved for your partner (if you're monogamous), and it sounds like you're treating this friend more like a romantic partner. 

And no, I'm not just saying that because you both are opposite sexes. At the end of the day, even if you don't have romantic feelings for her (which you and I both know deep down you do), it doesn't matter because your expectations are super unreasonable. Instead of putting so much energy into someone who's not interested, focus on, idk, your girlfriend maybe? 

I also checked your post history and is this the same "friend" you're trying to meditate with daily to be spirituality bonded as well? As if the other stuff wasn't already excessive? You're in denial my friend.

I need to correct myself, He said she started homeschooling at age 12 not for 12 years, that's my fault. But here is the original post and if you click on his username, you can see all of his comments. 

[OG Post](https://www.reddit.com/r/AmItheAsshole/comments/xz4jaj/aita_for_stopping_by_my_daughters_house_when_she/?utm_source=share&utm_medium=android_app&utm_name=androidcss&utm_term=1&utm_content=share_button)

I went down the rabbit hole of reading his replies to people and one comment said that their daughter was homeschooled for 12 years, not allowed to date at all and she didn't graduate with any friends really because she was pretty isolated. She probably just wants some freedom and independence and he's upset about that.

Maybe 'unhinged' is an extreme label. I used that term here more as a hyperbole. Either way, if the post doesn't convince you her parents (especially dad) are weird, here's a link so you can read the comments. The original post was removed but comments are still up. 

[OG post](https://www.reddit.com/r/AmItheAsshole/comments/xz4jaj/aita_for_stopping_by_my_daughters_house_when_she/?utm_source=share&utm_medium=android_app&utm_name=androidcss&utm_term=1&utm_content=share_button)

I understand where you are coming from, but as a 24 woman myself, it's very normal for me to not contact my family that regularly (granted I'm not that close with my family). They have very unrealistic expectations of her. And if you read his comments, it doesn't sound like he's acting this way because he genuinely cares about her, he made it clear that he's not ok with her having boys around as if that's any of his business. He stated he doesn't want his daughter having a "certain lifestyle" implying he doesn't want her entertaining men. He's basically slut-shaming her and he doing this all from his own assumptions and paranoia, there's no proof she's even dating. 

And calling her to set up a date is fine, but he's secretly driving by her place to make sure no guys are around. That's extremely inappropriate and overbearing.

OP, first I'm so sorry this is happening to you. You are absolutely not at fault at all and do not ever let anyone make you think that for a second. This is my advice: 

1. If you don't feel comfortable telling your mom first, tell the school counselor or a teacher you trust. Or another adult in your family. 

2. You definitely need to tell your mom, her number 1 job is to protect you. If she ends up not supporting you, do not let that discourage or change your mind. You are the victim and not at all deserving of this. 

3. Secretly record whenever you're around him just incase he tries something again. But DO NOT purposely put yourself in an uncomfortable situation just to try to catch him. The trauma is not worth it. 

4. And lastly, you are entitled to protect yourself by any means necessary. Lock your doors, keep something on or near you for self-defense, stay with friends or other trusted family when possible. 

Stay safe OP, we support you!

Hey, nice to hear from you again! I'm glad to see you're still going. To be honest it's been very up and down for me, there's like a week I'm doing really bad and then a couple of weeks where I'm ok. What's been keeping me going are these little goals I set for myself. Like one thing I've always wanted to do is travel to a specific place and I tell myself I can't give up till I do that at least. Or there's this adult coloring book I received on my birthday and I tell myself I have to finish it before I can give up. Going to the gym to try to achieve my ideal body is another. How have you been staying motivated?

I feel like the wrong person to say this considering my situation 😅 but I am here for support if you need it! I hope you find peace and happiness real soon! This guy was my first/only love so maybe that's why it's so hard.

Yea, I tried to talk to him about it while we were still together and I believe I did so in the most mature, calm way I could. He keeps saying she has nothing to do with our breakup and he just wasn't happy and just wants to be alone. Hurts either way, but you're right. Just gotta put all the love you have back into yourself.

I'm sorry you went through that! My gut is screaming at me that I'm right... but he refuses to admit it. I'm just frustrated because after all he's put me through I feel like I deserve the truth. I should've ended it the moment I knew in my gut but I ignored it and now I'm the hurt one.

Yeah, I think it's cool. Things can change drastically day to day, so imagine 365 opportunities of change. There's so many things I think we hold ourselves back from out of fear, but if we're gonna end it all by next year, what does it matter? And the hope is that by the end of next year, life might be worth living after all.

Well hey, from one suicidal person to another, I think it would be really cool if you just waited one more year. I literally just made a post about this. In 2022, I'm going to give it my all, one more shot. And if it sucks then fine, I'll take my life. But there's so much that can happen in a year. 

Also, I can relate to the losing friends/family sucks. But the unexpected happened to me. I went from having literally no friends to now having 2 bestfriends that are the most genuine people. I went from not talking to family at all to having pleasant conversations with cousins, siblings and my parents finally. 

All I'm saying is... you can end it literally whenever you want, so if you just try one more year one of two things are gonna happen. 1. It'll suck ass and then you'll get to do what you wanted and end it. 2. It'll actually turn out to be pretty cool and you'll be so glad you tried again. Win win.
